text:
maria: quick sync — doing RC smoke run tonight for SDK v0.10 + sample apps. Owners: SDK packaging @alex, sample apps @jonathan, docs/changelog @sara. Can owners confirm they're good for a 7pm UTC smoke window and list any blockers?

alex: I can own SDK packaging. There's a packaging bug with native wheels on mac that I want to patch before smoke. Targeting a small patch by 5:30pm UTC. Will post PR.

jonathan: sample apps: failing in CI on the node14 image — some test env var missing. I pushed a fix branch but waiting on a runtime secret from infra. pinging @kevin for short-term secret access.

kevin: pulling the secret now. quick note: Dedicated infra will be doing a maintenance at 8pm UTC; if smoke run overlaps, routing might be flaky. Recommend sliding to 6:30-7:30 to avoid the 8pm window. :thinking_face:

sara: docs/changelog: cutoff is 6pm UTC. I can accept small late changelog entries if they are doc-only and under 200 words. Otherwise they'll go to next minor. Filing a CHANGESET tag guideline: `docs: short note (<=200w) — release manager signoff` — I can sign off.

maria: ok timeline -> cutoff 6pm docs, packaging patch by 5:30, sample apps PR by 5:45, smoke run start 6:30 for 1 hour. Does that work?

jonathan: sample apps PR merged to rc branch but CI still flakey — here's failing log: 
```
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '/tmp/sa/env.json'
at Object.openSync (...)
```
I added a fallback in the branch.

ci-bot: build/1968-rc-smoke #42: sampleapps/docker-image failed on node14. Rerun queued.

alex: added packaging patch PR #512. @maria can you trigger the packaging pipeline? `./scripts/release/build_wheels.sh --rc` — I tested locally.

maria: triggered packaging; watch logs. If infra maintenance kicks in we'll fallback to hosted binary for smoke tests. Also please add a smoke checklist comment on PRs: "smoke-ready: yes"

kevin: secret injected. sampleapps CI started passing on rerun. :thumbsup:

sara: added changelog entry for `quickstart-js` sample under rc notes. tagging @maria for signoff.

maria: thanks all. If anything else pops up drop updates here. I'll post final go/no-go 6:15pm UTC. :rocket:
